extracted.name: Arugula, Fennel, and Orange Salad
extracted.description: This arugula, fennel, and orange salad has a tasty honey and lemon juice dressing drizzled over the recipe. You can also substitute celery for fennel.
instruction_lines: Whisk together honey, lemon juice, salt, and pepper; slowly add olive oil while continuing to whisk.
Place arugula in the bottom of a salad bowl; scatter orange segments, fennel slices, and olives over arugula; drizzle dressing over salad to serve.
